points.text:
$\text{H}_0$: Population mean no. enquiries $= 1.55$

$\text{H}_1$: Population mean no. enquiries $> 1.55$
points.guidance:
Or “population mean no. enquiries = 0.31 (per minute)” oe.

Allow '$\lambda = 1.55$’ or $\mu = \text{‘}1.55\text{’}$.
Allow one end error, e.g. extra term: $\text{e}^{-1.55} \times \frac{1.55^5}{5!}$.

Allow 0.021.

**SC B1** no working scores B1 instead of M1A1.

points.text: [Reject $\text{H}_0$] There is sufficient evidence [at 2.5% level] to suggest that mean no. of enquiries has increased.
points.guidance:
In context, not definite, e.g., not "Mean no. of enquiries has increased".

No contradictions.
